$comment: ERROR-CATALOGUE-1: the cause and the fix of every refusal code, keyed by code. tools/render-error-catalogue.mjs reads the code set and each HTTP status from the Java constants, and fails when a code has no entry here or an entry names no code. 'status' overrides the derived HTTP status.

MALFORMED_REQUEST.cause: The request could not be read: the body is not a JSON object, a required field or query parameter is missing, or a value has the wrong type or format.
MALFORMED_REQUEST.fix: Read the message — it names the field and the shape it wants. Send a JSON object body with every required field, then retry.

NOT_FOUND.cause: Nothing exists at this path or id: a misspelled route, an id that was never created or was deleted, or a name in another Space.
NOT_FOUND.fix: List the collection first (the matching GET) and use an id from it; check the Space in the path. A route of a switched-off module answers MODULE_DISABLED, not this.

METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.cause: The path exists but does not take this HTTP method.
METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.fix: Use the method the API contract (docs/api/openapi-v1.json) lists for this path.

PATH_JAIL_VIOLATION.cause: A path in the request leaves the folder it must stay in (the config root, the data root or a Space's allowed folders), or a draft names a config file a caller may not reach.
PATH_JAIL_VIOLATION.fix: Use a path relative to the Space's own folders, with no '..' and no absolute path outside the allowed roots; for a config reference, name the component (kind/name), not a file.

CONFLICT.cause: The request clashes with what exists: the name is already taken, the target is used by other configs, or the object is in a state that refuses this action.
CONFLICT.fix: Read the message and details: pick another name, or repoint or remove the dependents it lists. Some deletes accept ?force=true when the message says so.

CONFLICT_STALE_VERSION.cause: The object changed after you read it: the If-Match version you sent is no longer current, or a concurrent writer kept winning.
CONFLICT_STALE_VERSION.fix: GET the object again, re-apply your change to the fresh copy, and resend with its new version or ETag in If-Match.

CONFIG_VALIDATION_FAILED.cause: The request parsed but its content is refused: a config that would not load or run, a value out of range, an unknown key, or a reference to something that does not exist. The default code of every 422.
CONFIG_VALIDATION_FAILED.fix: Read error.message and every ERROR in error.details.findings[]: each names its fieldPath, often a code (listed under Config finding codes) and guidance. Fix them all, then resubmit; preview or validate routes check a draft without saving it.

INTERNAL.cause: The server failed while answering — a defect or an outage, not a problem with the request.
INTERNAL.fix: Retry once. If it repeats, report it with the correlationId from the body; the server log carries the cause under that id.

CONTROL_PLANE_READ_ONLY.cause: Config writes are switched off on this server: it was started without a config write root.
CONTROL_PLANE_READ_ONLY.fix: An operator restarts the server with -Dassist.write.root=<config folder>. Reads keep working meanwhile.

CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.cause: The route needs a module or a service this install does not have — not installed in this edition, or a dependency (such as the run lease database) is down.
CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Check GET /health/details and the edition. Install or enable the module, or wait for the dependency; this is not fixed by changing the request.

STORE_BUSY.cause: A shared store is locked by another request or server and did not free within the bounded wait.
STORE_BUSY.fix: Retry after a short wait. Nothing in the request needs to change.

UNAUTHENTICATED.cause: The request carries no credentials, or they are invalid or expired.
UNAUTHENTICATED.fix: Sign in again, or refresh the token or API key the request carries.

PERMISSION_DENIED.cause: You are signed in, but your role lacks the Capability this route requires, or the object belongs to a Space or share you cannot reach. An agent is also refused routes outside its allowed set.
PERMISSION_DENIED.fix: The message names the Capability. Ask an administrator for a role that holds it, or, for an agent, propose the change for a person to approve instead of calling the route.

RATE_LIMITED.cause: Too many expensive requests from you in a short time: your request budget for this route is spent, or one call alone costs more than the whole budget.
RATE_LIMITED.fix: When a Retry-After header is present, wait that many seconds and retry. When it is absent, or the message says the call is over the budget, retrying will not help: make the call cheaper (fewer rows, a smaller range) or batch and cache reads.

NOT_SUPPORTED.cause: The route exists but cannot do this for this target on this host — for example run-to-here on a Collector that does not read files.
NOT_SUPPORTED.fix: Use the alternative the message names, or a different target.

PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.cause: The request is over one of the route's caps: the body size (an agent's preview, simulator and MCP bodies are capped at 256 KiB) or a count or quota the message names.
PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.fix: Send less: split the change, page an upload, or reference the data by name instead of inlining it; stay under the limit the message names.

INTEGRITY_VIOLATION.cause: Stored evidence disagrees with its own recorded hashes, so the store is refused rather than read.
INTEGRITY_VIOLATION.fix: Not fixable from the request. Report it with the correlationId; an operator restores the store from backup or investigates the tampering.

MODULE_DISABLED.cause: The route belongs to a module that is installed but switched off in this Space.
MODULE_DISABLED.fix: An administrator switches the module on for the Space (PUT /settings/modules), or use a Space where it is on.

ERR_SAFETY_POLICY_UNREADABLE.cause: A Safety Policy file in scope exists but cannot be read as a valid policy, so every gate and run in its scope fails closed.
ERR_SAFETY_POLICY_UNREADABLE.fix: An operator fixes or removes the Space's config/safety-policy.toon (GET /health names the unreadable file), then retries.

ENTITLEMENT_READ_ONLY.cause: The install is read-only: its entitlement expired and the grace period ended, or a trial build has no entitlement. Reads continue.
ENTITLEMENT_READ_ONLY.fix: An administrator installs a renewed entitlement; writes resume without a restart.

DEMO_ROSTER_CONFLICT.cause: One demo user is defined differently in two Spaces attached to the same demo server. Demo builds only.
DEMO_ROSTER_CONFLICT.fix: Make that user's row in config/demo-users.toon identical in both Spaces, or attach only one of them, then restart the demo server.

SPACE_LOCATIONS_DISABLED.cause: No folders are allowed for Spaces on this server (spaces.allowed.roots unset), so every route that takes a Space folder is off.
SPACE_LOCATIONS_DISABLED.fix: An operator sets -Dspaces.allowed.roots (or the SPACES_ALLOWED_ROOTS environment variable) to the folders Spaces may use and restarts the server.

SPACE_HOLDS_DATA.cause: The Space already holds data, so its data folder cannot be changed here.
SPACE_HOLDS_DATA.fix: Leave the Space's data folder as it is; to use another folder, create a new Space there.

ERR_ARMED_WITHOUT_SCHEMA.cause: The Pipeline is active but has no schema at all, so it would register and then be skipped every cycle.
ERR_ARMED_WITHOUT_SCHEMA.fix: Give it a schema (processing.schema_file or processing.schemas), or save it with active: false until it has one.

ERR_ROUTE_UNARMABLE.cause: An active Pipeline's route: block would refuse to arm; the finding's message names each reason.
ERR_ROUTE_UNARMABLE.fix: Correct the branch at the finding's fieldPath as its message and guidance say, or save with active: false and fix it before activating.

WARN_ROUTE_UNARMABLE.cause: The same route: problem as ERR_ROUTE_UNARMABLE on an inactive draft; it will refuse at activation.
WARN_ROUTE_UNARMABLE.fix: Correct the branch before you set active: true.

ERR_STEP_DISABLE_UNPARKABLE.cause: An active Pipeline lists processing.disabled_steps that cannot be parked. Only the sinks of route: branches can be disabled; an unknown or upstream step, the route node itself, every branch at once, or a Pipeline with no dirs.backup is refused.
ERR_STEP_DISABLE_UNPARKABLE.fix: Disable only route-branch sinks, keep at least one branch live, and set dirs.backup; to stop everything, save active: false instead.

WARN_STEP_DISABLE_UNPARKABLE.cause: The same disabled_steps problem on an inactive draft; it will refuse at activation.
WARN_STEP_DISABLE_UNPARKABLE.fix: Correct disabled_steps before you set active: true.

ERR_DEDUP_WINDOW_UNARMABLE.cause: An active windowed dedup (scope: window(...)) has no order_by tie-break, or its scope: value is malformed — a durable ledger must never record a random winner.
ERR_DEDUP_WINDOW_UNARMABLE.fix: Add an order_by that picks one winner per key, and write scope as window(<duration>).

WARN_DEDUP_WINDOW_UNARMABLE.cause: The same windowed-dedup problem on an inactive draft; it will refuse at activation.
WARN_DEDUP_WINDOW_UNARMABLE.fix: Add order_by and a valid scope before you set active: true.

ERR_CHAIN_WITHOUT_OUTPUT_STORE.cause: An active Pipeline has chain Steps (steps:, or processing.dedup / summarize / profile / join) but no top-level output_store:, so the chain never runs.
ERR_CHAIN_WITHOUT_OUTPUT_STORE.fix: Add output_store: naming the Dataset the chain writes, and a pipeline Job that runs it.

WARN_CHAIN_WITHOUT_OUTPUT_STORE.cause: The same missing output_store: on an inactive draft; it will refuse at activation.
WARN_CHAIN_WITHOUT_OUTPUT_STORE.fix: Add output_store: before you set active: true.

WARN_CHAIN_WITHOUT_PIPELINE_JOB.cause: The Pipeline has a chain and an output_store:, but no enabled Job of type: pipeline names its file, so the chain never runs.
WARN_CHAIN_WITHOUT_PIPELINE_JOB.fix: Create or enable a Job with type: pipeline and pipeline_config: naming this Pipeline's file.

ERR_STEP_CONFIG_INVALID.cause: An active Pipeline's lookup, profile, dedup or filter Step would be refused at run time: a required key is missing or malformed, or it names a column the declared schema does not carry.
ERR_STEP_CONFIG_INVALID.fix: Fix the Step at the finding's fieldPath: add the missing key, or use a column the schema declares (check spelling and case).

WARN_STEP_CONFIG_INVALID.cause: The same Step problem on an inactive draft; it will refuse at activation.
WARN_STEP_CONFIG_INVALID.fix: Fix the Step before you set active: true.

ERR_COLLECTOR_CONFIG_INVALID.cause: An active Pipeline's Collector cannot be honoured — for example post_action on_success: MOVE with no archive_path.
ERR_COLLECTOR_CONFIG_INVALID.fix: Set collector.post_action.archive_path (for example archive/yyyy/MM/dd), or choose RETAIN, DELETE or RENAME.

WARN_COLLECTOR_CONFIG_INVALID.cause: The same Collector problem on an inactive draft; it will refuse at activation.
WARN_COLLECTOR_CONFIG_INVALID.fix: Fix the Collector before you set active: true.

WARN_COLLECTOR_KEY_INERT.cause: Remote-only Collector keys (fetch, retry, circuit_breaker, a non-RETAIN post_action) on a Collector that reads a local inbox — they are accepted but never act.
WARN_COLLECTOR_KEY_INERT.fix: Bind a remote Connection, or remove the keys; a local inbox's throttle is processing.intake.

ERR_SINK_DUCKLAKE_SHARED_TABLE.cause: Two sinks[] destinations register into the same DuckLake catalog and table, so every batch would insert both destinations' files into it.
ERR_SINK_DUCKLAKE_SHARED_TABLE.fix: Give each destination its own DuckLake table, or merge them into one destination.

ERR_EDITION_FEATURE.cause: The config uses a feature this edition does not include — Alert Rules, the post_action MOVE archive, or DuckLake registration (Standard and Advanced only).
ERR_EDITION_FEATURE.fix: Remove the feature from the config, or run the Standard or Advanced edition.

ERR_ROUTE_PREDICATE_COLUMN.cause: An active route: branch's where: reads a column the declared schema does not carry, so the branch would fail on the first row.
ERR_ROUTE_PREDICATE_COLUMN.fix: Use a column the schema declares in the where: predicate (check spelling and case), or add the column to the schema.

WARN_ROUTE_PREDICATE_COLUMN.cause: The same unknown-column predicate on an inactive draft; it will refuse at activation.
WARN_ROUTE_PREDICATE_COLUMN.fix: Fix the where: predicate before you set active: true.

ERR_SUMMARIZE_MEASURE_TYPE.cause: An active summarize Step applies sum or avg to a field the schema declares as non-numeric; the database refuses it at run time.
ERR_SUMMARIZE_MEASURE_TYPE.fix: Aggregate a numeric field, use count / min / max, or declare the field with a numeric type in the schema.

WARN_SUMMARIZE_MEASURE_TYPE.cause: The same non-numeric measure on an inactive draft; it will refuse at activation.
WARN_SUMMARIZE_MEASURE_TYPE.fix: Fix the measure before you set active: true.

WARN_UNRESOLVED_CONNECTION.cause: An imported Pipeline binds a Connection this Space does not hold. Bundles never carry Connections (secrets never travel), so the import lands inactive.
WARN_UNRESOLVED_CONNECTION.fix: Create the named Connection in this Space, then activate the Pipeline.

ERR_WEBHOOK_CONNECTION_UNKNOWN.cause: A webhook: block names a Connection this Space does not hold, so every run would refuse before sending.
ERR_WEBHOOK_CONNECTION_UNKNOWN.fix: Create the Connection first, or name an existing https Connection.

ERR_WEBHOOK_CONNECTION_NOT_HTTPS.cause: A webhook: block names a Connection that is not an https one; the webhook sink accepts only https.

ERR_WEBHOOK_INVALID.cause: The webhook: block itself is refused — an inline url: or token:, an unknown key, no connection, or a batch_size out of bounds. The message is the parser's own.
ERR_WEBHOOK_INVALID.fix: Put the URL and secret in an https Connection and name it in connection:; remove unknown keys; keep batch_size within the bounds the message gives.

ERR_EXCEL_INVALID.cause: The excel: block is refused — no path, a path leaving the data root, a bad or duplicate sheet name, max_rows out of bounds, an unknown key, or a sheet sql the SQL guard refuses.
ERR_EXCEL_INVALID.fix: Correct the item the message names: a relative path under the data root, unique sheet names, max_rows within bounds, a plain SELECT for sheet sql.

ERR_LOOKUP_ON_INGEST.cause: A processing.map.fields[] row calls lookup.reference; the ingest lane cannot resolve a Reference, so every batch would fail.
ERR_LOOKUP_ON_INGEST.fix: Move the lookup into a Pipeline transform.sql Step or a transform.join; keep the mapping row to plain expressions.

ERR_SCHEMA_FILE_UNRESOLVED.cause: An active Pipeline's schema_file resolves to no file beside its config, so it would register and never load.
ERR_SCHEMA_FILE_UNRESOLVED.fix: Name the schema file as it is saved (usually <name>.toon in the same folder), or save the Schema first.

WARN_SCHEMA_FILE_UNRESOLVED.cause: The same unresolved schema_file on an inactive draft; it will refuse at activation.
WARN_SCHEMA_FILE_UNRESOLVED.fix: Fix schema_file before you set active: true.

ERR_SELECTOR_NOT_INDEX.cause: A delimited or fixed-width Pipeline's schema selects a column by name where the load needs its zero-based index in raw.fields[].selector.
ERR_SELECTOR_NOT_INDEX.fix: Set each raw.fields[].selector to the column's zero-based position (0, 1, 2, …).

ERR_UNKNOWN_CONFIG_KEY.cause: The config carries a block or key no component reads; the engine would ignore it and what it configures would be lost.
ERR_UNKNOWN_CONFIG_KEY.fix: Remove the key, or move it to where the component reads it (check spelling and nesting against the kind's shape).

WARN_UNKNOWN_CONFIG_KEY.cause: The same unread key in a config already on disk, reported while reading rather than saving.
WARN_UNKNOWN_CONFIG_KEY.fix: Remove or move the key at the next edit.

ERR_UNKNOWN_CLASSIFICATION.cause: A column carries a classification this Space does not know, so it would mask nothing.
ERR_UNKNOWN_CLASSIFICATION.fix: Use a classification the Space defines (its Entity Types and masking classes), or define the new class first.

ERR_SAFETY_STATE_ADVANCE_REFUSED.cause: The config would advance progress state (a remote, database-export or Kafka Collector, content dedup, markers with duplicate_check, windowed dedup, a Job's incremental_column) in a Space whose Safety Policy sets permit.advance_state: false.
ERR_SAFETY_STATE_ADVANCE_REFUSED.fix: Remove the state-advancing setting, or have an administrator allow it in the Space's Safety Policy.

ERR_STEP_COLUMN_METADATA_INVALID.cause: A sql Step's fields[] row carries column metadata (description, unit, classification, synonym) that is not a plain string, or names no distinct output column (blank or duplicate name).
ERR_STEP_COLUMN_METADATA_INVALID.fix: Give each fields[] row a unique name matching an output column, and plain string metadata values.

ERR_COLUMN_BREAKS.cause: The Schema save removes, renames or narrows a column another config uses, and the Space's Safety Policy sets columns: refuse-breaking.
ERR_COLUMN_BREAKS.fix: Repoint the consumers the body lists first, keep the column, or re-send with ?force=true to save anyway.

WARN_COLUMN_BREAKS.cause: The Schema save removes, renames or narrows a column another config uses; the save went ahead.
WARN_COLUMN_BREAKS.fix: Update the consumers the finding lists, or they fail at their next run.

ERR_LINK_DANGLING.cause: The saved config adds a link to a Pipeline, Connection or other config that does not exist, and the server refuses dangling links.
ERR_LINK_DANGLING.fix: Create the target first, or correct the name at the finding's fieldPath.

WARN_LINK_DANGLING.cause: The saved config links to something that does not exist; the save went ahead.
WARN_LINK_DANGLING.fix: Create the target or correct the name, or the config fails when it runs.

EMPTY_GRAPH.cause: The Pipeline graph has no nodes.
EMPTY_GRAPH.fix: Add at least an entry node and the Steps it feeds.

DUPLICATE_NODE.cause: Two nodes in the graph share one id.
DUPLICATE_NODE.fix: Give every node a unique id, and update the edges that point at the renamed one.

DANGLING_FROM.cause: An edge starts at a node id the graph does not have.
DANGLING_FROM.fix: Correct the edge's from: to an existing node id, or add the node.

DANGLING_TO.cause: An edge points at a node id the graph does not have.
DANGLING_TO.fix: Correct the edge's to: to an existing node id, or add the node.

CYCLE.cause: Data edges form a loop; a Pipeline must be a directed graph without cycles.
CYCLE.fix: Remove one edge of the loop the message lists.

NO_ENTRY.cause: Every node has an inbound edge, so nothing starts the Pipeline.
NO_ENTRY.fix: Make one node an entry (no inbound edge) — usually the Collector or input node.

ILLEGAL_EMIT.cause: An edge uses a relationship its source node type does not emit.
ILLEGAL_EMIT.fix: Use one of the relationships the message lists for that node type.

ILLEGAL_ACCEPT.cause: An edge carries data into a node type that does not accept data.
ILLEGAL_ACCEPT.fix: Point the edge at a node that accepts it, or use a relationship the target accepts (the message lists them).

ILLEGAL_PAIRING.cause: An outcome or route edge targets a node that can neither accept that relationship nor read it as rows — an entry node, or a specialised consumer fed the wrong stream.
ILLEGAL_PAIRING.fix: Point the edge at a Step or sink that takes rows, or at a consumer of that relationship.

UNKNOWN_TYPE.cause: A node's type is not registered in this build, so its wiring cannot be checked (warning).
UNKNOWN_TYPE.fix: Check the type's spelling against the node types this edition lists; install the module that contributes it.

RETIRED_RELATION.cause: An edge named a relation retired in 4.0.0 (success, failure, on_commit); it was dropped when the graph was read (warning, the run is unchanged).
RETIRED_RELATION.fix: Remove the edge, or rewire it with a current relationship.

NODE_MODE_UNDECLARED.cause: A contributed node type declares no mode, so the graph is refused at arming.
NODE_MODE_UNDECLARED.fix: The module providing the node type must declare its mode; use a built-in type until it does.

SQL_STEP_UNAUDITED.cause: A transform.sql node runs hand-written SQL, which the batch's cast-failure audit does not cover (warning; never blocks a save).
SQL_STEP_UNAUDITED.fix: Nothing required. Prefer select / derive Steps when you want cast failures audited.

UNKNOWN_USE_KIND.cause: A node's use: names a component kind that does not exist.
UNKNOWN_USE_KIND.fix: Write use: as <kind>/<name> with a component kind this Space has (for example grammar/<name>).

UNKNOWN_USE_REF.cause: A node's use: names a component of a known kind that does not exist — often a typo.
UNKNOWN_USE_REF.fix: Name an existing component (list that kind first), or create it.

JOIN_REFERENCE_MISSING.cause: A transform.join node names no reference. A save refuses it with this as the error.errorCode of a 422 as well.
JOIN_REFERENCE_MISSING.fix: Set reference: to reference/<pipeline> or a data-file path.

JOIN_ON_MISSING.cause: A transform.join node names no on: key column(s).
JOIN_ON_MISSING.fix: Set on: to the key column, or a list of them, present on both sides.

JOIN_MATCH_UNKNOWN.cause: A transform.join node's match: is not a mode the join runs.
JOIN_MATCH_UNKNOWN.fix: Use one of the match modes the message lists.

JOIN_KEYED_INVALID.cause: A keyed transform.join's settings cannot run, judged from the config alone.
JOIN_KEYED_INVALID.fix: Correct the key settings the message names.

UNKNOWN_JOIN_REFERENCE.cause: A transform.join's reference: names a Pipeline or file that does not exist.
UNKNOWN_JOIN_REFERENCE.fix: Name an existing Reference Pipeline or data file, or create it first.

COMPONENT_INVALID.cause: POST /validate: the component draft is refused as a whole — the message is the refusal the save would give.
COMPONENT_INVALID.fix: Fix what the message names (a missing required key, a bad value, a reference to nothing), then validate again before saving.

UNKNOWN_KEY.severity: ERROR for an agent, WARNING for a person
UNKNOWN_KEY.cause: The component carries a key nothing reads. A person's save keeps it with no effect (warnings[].code); an agent's save is refused.
UNKNOWN_KEY.fix: Remove the key or correct its spelling against the kind's shape; prefix it with x- to mark it as deliberately extra.
